label: preparing
what: A surprise tribute marking my forty years as mayor, in the great hall at 18:00, disguised as Builder's lighting inspection. Innkeeper arranges bread, Freight delivers and seeks supply financing, and Builder arranges the inspection pretext and lighting. Secretary knowingly coordinates attendance and requests funds for seventy-two additional tribute loaves; Baker is helping with bread supply. I have since learned of the surprise through Secretary, though not directly from its organizers.
